usedFor: My Hours holds time-tracked projects, and GitHub receives matching work through “Create Issue” and “Create Branch” in a repo.

bestTemplate.name: “New Project” in My Hours, then “Create Issue” in GitHub
bestTemplate.why: A new tracked project can open its first issue so engineering has a place to start.

watchOut: “New Project” in My Hours is polling, so “Create Issue” in GitHub follows a scheduled check, not the save.
